question: Start design on the pi-subagents probe paths in spacedock doctor --host pi?

artifacts.summary: The pi doctor probes src/extension/index.ts and src/intercom/intercom-bridge.ts. pi-subagents 0.74.0 ships compiled output and declares its entry as ./index.js, so both probes report MISSING against a correct install, and the printed remedy reports up to date. Four call sites hardcode the source paths in internal/cli/pi.go, and the existing test fabricates the same paths, which is why it passed.
